hypothesis: Among a fixed liquid large-cap universe, stocks with positive 20-session relative strength, a close above their 50-session SMA, and broadening 5-session volume may continue to outperform over the next week. Volume expansion is a participation check, not a claim of proven alpha.
universe_note: Fixed list declared before evaluation. It is not a point-in-time index membership list, so survivorship and selection bias are limitations. No symbol may be added or removed after the evaluation starts.

data.source: Moomoo REST history-kline daily bars for each symbol and SPY
data.adjustment: forward-adjusted OHLC as returned by the documented history-kline request; volume is the provider daily volume
data.context_only_note: Moomoo pattern or indicator readings may be stored as timestamped research context, but they must not create, veto or rank a signal.

evaluation_window.note: This window is separate from the ETF holdout used earlier. The 2025-2026 fixture is not used to tune or validate this protocol.

signal.frequency: weekly, using the last fully completed session of the week
signal.regime: SPY close > SPY 200-session simple moving average, including the signal session
stock_filters: stock close > stock 50-session simple moving average, including the signal session
signal.ranking: eligible stocks sorted by 20-session return descending, then symbol ascending
signal.selection: top 3 eligible stocks; hold fewer if fewer qualify; never substitute outside the eligible set

portfolio_and_execution.execution: next session open after the weekly signal
portfolio_and_execution.rebalance: weekly at the next open; sell names no longer selected and buy newly selected names
portfolio_and_execution.exit: weekly rebalance; if the SPY regime is false, sell all holdings at the next open and hold cash

benchmarks: SPY on the strategy's weekly target gross exposure (same-schedule exposure-matched)
equal-weight fixed universe on the same weekly schedule and 30% gross cap
evaluation_plan.reporting: Publish all results, including losses and years with no eligible names. Do not call the result out-of-sample alpha unless the pre-registered window and benchmark rules were unchanged.
evaluation_plan.rejection_rule: If the single run does not beat the same-schedule SPY and equal-weight universe comparators after costs, or if the result depends on a handful of trades, reject the hypothesis and do not tune it on the same window.

deployment_blockers: The RiskGate allowlist is currently {SPY, QQQ, IWM}; this protocol would require an owner-approved universe expansion.
No order transport exists and ORDER_WRITES_ENABLED is false.
The first paper order requires explicit owner approval and a verified broker lifecycle.
This protocol has no backtest, no forward paper observation and no independent alpha evidence yet.
prohibitions: No parameter grid, threshold search or repeated tuning of the evaluation window.
No reuse of the existing ETF holdout as evidence for this stock hypothesis.
No Moomoo snapshot-only pattern or polarity label as a mandatory entry condition.
No provider indicator-backtest success rates as historical evidence.
No deployment, allowlist change or order submission under this proposal.
